svg.title: RAVDESS Project Roadmap
svg.desc: Full pipeline from data loading to model comparison for RAVDESS emotion recognition

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me code for loading and parsing RAVDESS dataset filenames')
g.text: Parse emotion, actor, modality from RAVDESS filename codes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me EDA code with visualizations for RAVDESS dataset')
g.text: Class distribution, waveforms, spectrograms, duration stats

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me audio preprocessing and feature extraction code for RAVDESS using librosa')
g.text: MFCC, Mel spectrogram, chroma, ZCR, RMS — via librosa

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me how to split RAVDESS data into train/val/test sets properly')
g.text: Stratified split by emotion label, handle class imbalance

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me the 3 best models to implement for RAVDESS emotion recognition with code')
g.text: CNN + LSTM · MLP baseline · SVM / XGBoost

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me training loop and evaluation metrics code for RAVDESS emotion classification')
g.text: Accuracy, F1, confusion matrix, ROC-AUC per model

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me how to compare and visualize model results for RAVDESS project')
g.text: Side-by-side metrics table, bar chart, best model analysis
